changelog:
Initial release. Instantly repurpose content into 10+ formats for various platforms.

- Supports Twitter thread, LinkedIn post, blog intro, email newsletter, Discord, Reddit, Quora, Instagram, subject lines, and meta descriptions.
- Auto-detects content type or allows manual override.
- Various output tones: professional (default), casual, humorous, inspirational, or technical.
- Outputs all formats as structured JSON with robust error handling.
- Supports output to file directory and handles rate limiting.
summary: Convert any text into 10+ marketing formats like Twitter threads, LinkedIn posts, blog intros, email newsletters, social announcements, and meta descriptions.
